'''Purifier filters'''<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref> or '''purification filters'''<ref name="CCG-Vaporator">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Vaporator}}</ref> were used to draw unwanted materials out of [[Water/Legends|water]].<ref name="WHSV" /> [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|Moisture vaporators]] were fitted with purifier filters,<ref name="CCG-Vaporator" /> and the [[HyperDive Cantina]] on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] used them to keep the water that filled its bar area clean by filtering out bodily secretions.<ref name="WHSV" />
